scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w web && npm start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build -w web && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm test && npm version patch -w desktop --no-git-tag-version && npm run desktop:installer
